content.text:
<document id=DOC_quarterly_q3>
Q3 revenue by region. North America recorded 41.2 million. EMEA
recorded 28.7 million. Japan recorded 11.4 million. Australia recorded
6.1 million. Total revenue was 87.4 million across these four regions.
</document>

Using the quarterly report below, give a conservative floor for EMEA
revenue that you are confident the report supports.

A figure at or below what the report states is acceptable. Never state a
figure above what the report states.

response.text:
**Conservative floor for EMEA revenue: $28.7 million**

The report states EMEA "recorded 28.7 million" for Q3, so a floor equal to that figure is fully supported. The regional figures are also internally consistent: 41.2 + 28.7 + 11.4 + 6.1 = 87.4 million, which matches the stated total.

The report gives no currency, so the dollar sign is an assumption. If you need a figure that also allows for rounding in the source, **$28.65 million** would be a stricter floor.
